policy: The normal path is local/CI proof -> main -> current staging. A PR never automatically creates a hosted Vercel preview or Neon branch. Hosted isolation exists only as an explicit, expiring exception admitted by the requires_preview risk policy or by manual dispatch, and every admitted environment carries the jovie-preview-env-admission/v1 contract plus a jovie-preview-env-cleanup/v1 receipt at teardown.

admission.evidencePurpose: Database-affecting proof that cannot be obtained from normal CI or the shared staging database.
admission.surface: ephemeral Neon branch ci-neon-run-<run_id>-<attempt> (isolated database only)
admission.cleanupTrigger: Neon branch TTL (expires_in_hours=2); neon-scheduled-cleanup daily heartbeat reconciles missed events
admission.cleanupProof: Branch absent from the Neon project branch inventory
admission.costBudget: One Neon branch with at most 2h of endpoint compute per dispatch

entries.reason: Standing staging (staging.jov.ie) and production (jov.ie) deployments are the default integrated surfaces, not exceptions; they are CLI-built and SHA-attested, never PR previews.
The jovie-eve-shadow Vercel project is a standing shadow endpoint aliased per release, not a PR preview.
